construction_notes.text: Imported from the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, which cities file themselves and which runs through 2025. Not yet checked against the city's own project list.
The state report's rows for this project also name 1271 E Julian St, 1271 E. Julian St, 1530 W San Carlos St. These may be separate projects, and the unit count may include them.

CTCAC CA-23-440: Dry Creek Crossing , located at 2388 South Bascom Avenue in San Jose, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $2,894,579 in annual federal tax credits and $11,618,332 in total state tax credits to finance the new construction of 63 units of housing serving families with rents affordable to households earning 30%-70% of area median income (AMI). Recorded as a note because this funding covers Dry Creek Crossing (64 units), which may be one component of this record.

CTCAC CA-24-503: Julian Street Studios, located at 1271 & 1279 East Julian Street in San Jose on a 0.97 acre site, requested and is being recommended for a reservation of $6,379,444 in annual federal tax credits and $36,054,485 in total state tax credits and $65,400,000 of tax-exempt bond cap to finance the new construction of 305 units of housing, consisting of 301 restricted rental units and 4 manager's units. Recorded as a note because this funding covers Julian Street Studios (305 units), which may be one component of this record.
SJ Build lists MP22-006 as Dry Creek Crossing, 2388 S Bascom Ave, 64 units, CRP Affordable Housing, Complete.
SJ Build lists H22-033 as 1530 W San Carlos St, 237 units, Urban Villas LLC. A separate project from Dry Creek Crossing, combined here by the state import.
Split: Julian Street Studios (1271-1279 E Julian) now has its own record. This record's status, file numbers, and permit dates come from combined state report rows and may belong to either project.
